Civic Mail Hall

PIECES & MOTION

A place for every cat

Paper turntables, sleepy dogs and little deliveries. The hall is still shown as construction guides while its architecture is rebuilt.

About this study

All 15 original Office deliveries, on the accepted shared floor. Cats now leave their carriers, settle in baskets and fold away the empty boxes. Striped ginger and dotted blue turntables only turn their matching cats.

Next: the Civic Hall’s architecture, working postal activity and canal. Motion off still shows the actions needed to follow a delivery.
